caseName: Acker v. U.S. Dist. Court for the Dist. of Ariz.
caseNameFull: Christina Jay ACKER v. UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR the DISTRICT OF ARIZONA.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
